title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, 21 October 2026 — Yadollah Javani, Deputy for Political Affairs of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), said: “If our infrastructure is targeted, internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz will be targeted.”
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, 21 October 2026 — Yadollah Javani, Deputy for Political Affairs of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), said: “If our infrastructure is targeted, internet cables in the Strait of Hormuz will be targeted.”"

"Javani added: “The Americans must leave the region. They no longer have any place in our region, and they can never return conditions to how they were before the war.”"

""
"==========="

"SOT1, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:35): "The Americans and their allies possess significant assets in the region. If they wish to attack or damage our country's infrastructure, it is natural that the Islamic Republic will use its full capacity to destroy their assets and holdings with ease, including internet cables such as the seven major cables running beneath the Strait of Hormuz. It can certainly inflict serious damage on America or its allies in the region.""

"SOT2, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (00:36 - 01:17): "Because it is very difficult for our enemies to accept defeat and they are trying to change the circumstances, the Islamic Republic's actions will be calculated and at times aggressive. The Americans must leave our region; they no longer have a place here and can never restore conditions to how they were before the war. This shift to a more offensive strategy, and to actions that can strengthen our deterrence, is intended to make the Americans abandon any thought of aggression forever.""

"SOT3, Yadollah Javani, IRGC Political Deputy (Farsi) (01:18 - 01:41): "The Islamic Republic's defensive capabilities against aggressive actions, whether by the Americans, Europeans, Zionists, or countries that support the US, have become fully evident. Their bases in the region have been destroyed, and their bases can also be destroyed at greater distances, because the Islamic Republic has acquired the necessary technologies.
